# Veronica Pasqualin

> International Performance Digital Marketing Manager specialising in AI-driven search, with 8+ years of experience across PPC, SEO and GEO/AEO/AIO.

Veronica works at the intersection of international search, performance marketing, analytics and AI, helping brands stay discoverable across both traditional search engines (Google) and AI-powered search ecosystems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews).

## Background

- Senior International Digital Campaign Manager at Havas Market (2021–2026), working across EMEA/APAC markets and brands.
- Studying for an MSc in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Bath, focused on retrieval, tokenisation, and how language models process content.
- Applies GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) as an engineering discipline: entity optimisation, AI crawlability, structured data and content retrievability.

## Core expertise

- International SEO, PPC and GEO/AEO/AIO strategy
- Paid media across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube
- AI-driven search visibility and generative discovery strategy
- Data analysis and Python-based marketing analytics
